title: Consumer Care Assistant - Temporary
description:
Consumer Care Assistant - Temporary
Bournemouth Part-time Hybrid after training
2-3 days per week 3 - 4-month temporary assignment
Immediate start

We're looking for a friendly and organised Consumer Care Assistant to join a well-established consumer brand on an initial 3-4-month temporary assignment.

This is a great opportunity for someone with customer service experience who enjoys helping people, is confident communicating with customers and can pick up new systems quickly. You don't need years of experience. We're looking for someone with the right attitude, good judgement and a genuine focus on providing a great service.

The role will initially require in-person training in the Bournemouth office, particularly while you get to grips with the systems. Once fully trained, there will be flexibility to work remotely, although some office attendance would still be beneficial.

What you'll be doing
- Responding to customer enquiries across email and customer service systems
- Handling routine queries and complaints in a friendly and empathetic way
- Gathering relevant information and keeping accurate customer records
- Following cases through from initial enquiry to resolution
- Escalating more complex or sensitive queries when required
- Coordinating follow-ups and ensuring outstanding queries are actioned
- Spotting recurring customer questions or issues and flagging these to the wider team
- Arranging and sending product samples
- Working across different brands and systems in a busy customer-focused environment

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in customer service, retail, hospitality or another people-focused environment
- A confident and friendly communicator, both written and verbal
- Comfortable dealing with customer queries and complaints
- Calm and professional when dealing with dissatisfied customers
- Organised, accurate and able to manage several tasks at once
- Good attention to detail
- Confident using email and computer systems and able to learn new software quickly
- Proactive, reliable and keen to learn
- Able to recognise when something needs to be escalated
- Experience within food, online retail, e-commerce or subscription services would be helpful, but isn't essential. Training will be provided on the company's customer service systems.

The details
- Location: Bournemouth
- Working pattern: 2-3 days per week, minimum 2 days
- Contract: Temporary, initially 3-4 months
- Working arrangement: Office-based during initial training, with remote/hybrid working available once trained
- Start: Immediate

If you're looking for a flexible part-time opportunity where you can use your customer service skills within a supportive, people-focused team, we'd love to hear from you.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Care Assistant
company: Hamberley Care Management Limited - Company - Permanent
description:
Be all you can be with Hamberley
At Hamberley, we believe that our residents deserve something 'Extra Special, Every Day' and we're recruiting for a Care Assistant to help us achieve our goals.
At Upton Manor, our Care Assistants are called Homemakers. More than support workers, care assistants or healthcare assistants - they are carers and companions all in one. They have the time to get to know our residents and are trusted to give each person the care they need, in the way they like.
Joining us at Upton Manor, our luxury care home that provides residential, dementia, and nursing care for older people, you'll be part of a team that is genuinely passionate about the health and well-being of our residents.
Working Pattern: 12 hour shifts and working alternate weekends on a rota basis.
We offer our colleagues
- A competitive salary and benefits package
- 28 days holiday inclusive of Bank Holidays
- Quality-linked bonus scheme - A performance bonus tied to our CQC/CI quality rating, rewarding you for helping us deliver outstanding care.
- Workplace pension for your future security
- A true team culture - A collaborative, encouraging working environment where kindness, respect, and professional pride are at the heart of everything we do
- Excellent training and career development opportunities
- Employee Assistance Programme, occupational health and wellbeing support services
- Everyday saving perks - Access to a wide range of retail discounts and savings
- Free on-site parking
- Rewarding connections - Refer a Friend bonus - earn up to £750 per successful referral because great people know great people.

Be different - be a Homemaker
Be at the heart of our award winning homemaker care mode. A Homemaker is a unique caring role for a unique person, where you can care with a difference.
- A varied role where no two days are the same. Homemakers, our name for care assistants, care for individual people in the way a family member might care for someone in their home. We don't do timetabled task-based care - we care for each individual in the way that works best for them. Whether that's administering medication, helping make someone's bed, arranging a family meal with their loved ones or taking them to the beauty salon, you'll always be doing something different. Our Homemakers focus on the tiny details that make our residents unique, and tailor care to each and every individual.
- A chance to make a real difference to our residents' lives. Often healthcare assistants, care assistants and domiciliary care assistants find they don't get to spend enough time with the people they care for to make a real difference. Not at Hamberley. As a Homemaker you have fewer people to care for, but you spend more time with them. It's a more satisfying and fulfilling role that is better for our residents. That's why the model has won awards.
- Excellent opportunities for learning and development. We will support you with all the training you need, including NVQ qualifications and further clinical training if you want to specialise in areas like dementia and nutrition.
- Supportive team environment. Being kind and supportive to each other is key to our ability to show kindness and companionship to our residents. We truly believe this across all parts of our organisation. It's just one of the reasons that, when people join us, they stay with us.

Could you be part of our team?
We provide full training and induction, so we're more interested in you as a person than your specific care experience.
You may have experience as a healthcare assistant, care assistant, carer, home care assistant or domiciliary care assistant and are looking for a different approach, a nicer work environment and a more satisfying role.
If you have no work experience in care but are interested in helping people live happy lives, we'll guide you to a fantastic care assistant career at Hamberley.
What is important is that you have passion, empathy and dedication to help our residents live their lives to the fullest. We will support you with everything else!
If this sounds like you and you're looking for a fulfilling role that makes a genuine impact in the lives of others, this rewarding career is for you.
Due to the high level of interest we anticipate for this role, we may close this advert earlier than the stated closing date to manage applications effectively. If you're interested in joining us at Hamberley, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
About Upton Manor
Upton Manor is a luxurious care home in Poole, part of the award-winning Hamberley Care Homes - offering luxury care homes in beautiful locations throughout the UK. Residents live in spacious, stylish ensuite rooms, and enjoy beautifully furnished shared spaces and landscaped gardens. From the deluxe picture house - where we screen classic films - to the on-site luxury spa - offering hairdressing, manicures and relaxing therapies - everything has been designed and finished with the care and attention you would expect from a 5-star hotel.
Hamberley People
We respect and value our residents and each other. At Hamberley Care Homes, we believe in the importance of what we do and why we do it. Creative and empowered, our people see every day as an opportunity for growth and development. We make ideas happen. Together we can achieve anything.
Be part of something special. Be part of Hamberley.

title: Healthcare Assistant
company: RAL Community Care Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Introduction

We are looking for a caring, reliable and compassionate Healthcare Assistant to join the team in Dorset. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference by supporting individuals with their daily care needs and helping them maintain their independence, dignity and wellbeing.

About the Role / Objectives

As a Healthcare Assistant, you will provide person-centred support to individuals in a care environment. You will work as part of a supportive team, helping service users with their daily routines while promoting their comfort, dignity and quality of life.

The role requires someone who is patient, dependable and committed to delivering high-quality care.

Key Responsibilities
- Support individuals with their day-to-day care and wellbeing needs.
- Assist with personal care and daily activities where required.
- Encourage independence and support individuals to make their own choices.
- Monitor and report changes in wellbeing or behaviour to the appropriate team members.
- Communicate effectively with colleagues and other professionals involved in care.
- Maintain accurate and appropriate care records.
- Follow safeguarding, health and safety, infection control and other relevant procedures.
- Treat every individual with dignity, respect and compassion.

Requirements
- Previous experience working as a Healthcare Assistant or in a healthcare or care environment is desirable.
- A caring, compassionate and respectful approach.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- Reliable, responsible and committed to providing high-quality care.
- Ability to follow care plans, policies and procedures.
- Relevant qualifications or training, where required.

Please Note: Visa sponsorship/CoS is not available for this role. Applicants should already have the right to work in the UK.

Benefits
- Competitive pay in line with the role and experience.
- Opportunities to develop your skills and experience in care.
- Supportive working environment.
- Valuable experience within a professional care setting.
- Training and development opportunities, where available.
- Opportunity to make a positive difference to the lives of the people you support.

How to Apply

If you are a compassionate and dedicated Healthcare Assistant looking for an opportunity to make a real difference, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV and relevant experience. Successful candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps in the recruitment process.
